questions.stem: In the reaction 2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO, what mass of magnesium oxide is formed when 4.8 g of magnesium burns? (Ar: Mg = 24, O = 16)
questions.explanation: Moles of Mg = 4.8/24 = 0.2 mol. From the equation, the Mg:MgO ratio is 2:2, which is 1:1. So 0.2 mol Mg produces 0.2 mol MgO. Mr of MgO = 24 + 16 = 40. Mass = 0.2 × 40 = 8.0 g.
